about: Diner Dash: Hometown Hero is the fourth game in the line, developed and published by PlayFirst for windows in 2007. Flo comes home to find her hometown gone to seed, and the campaign rebuilds it venue by venue - five restaurants brought back to life, each with its own theme and customer mix.

It adds a playable second character and two-player co-op on one pc, plus a decorating layer between shifts. The build later reached steam on 12 august 2009 as part of the publisher's store batch - and unlike most of the line, that listing still sells the game today.
The official route exists, which makes this the exception case on the shelf: buyable on steam, with the archive routes riding along for the original-era builds.
